title: Screen layout
purpose: Choose a screen's frame from the person's task, the one thing that leads and the one primary action, instead of inheriting a sidebar, a top bar and a grid of cards.
useWhen: Composing a new screen or a new app, before choosing where anything goes.
avoidWhen: Copying the records frame (sidebar, filtered table, record in a sheet) for a screen whose task isn't working through many similar records.
alternatives: Inside a chosen frame, follow the task pattern for the work itself: edit record, consequential action, review and submit, async collection.
requiredInputs: the task in one sentence: who is here and what they came to do
the one thing that leads the screen
the one primary action, or none
what the person does next once the task is done
transitions: task-named → frame-chosen from the frame table, never by default
frame-chosen → built with the lead first in reading order and largest in the view
built → checked-against-task: each stated choice is visible, or the record or the screen changes
task-done → the next thing, said where the lead was
applicability: Any new screen: its frame, what leads it and where its one primary action sits.
exceptions: An existing product keeps its navigation frame; choose the frame of the view inside it from the task.
